About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the Role
We're seeking an exceptional Research Engineer to join our Life Sciences team at Anthropic. Our team is organized around the north star goal of accelerating progress in the life sciences, from early discovery through translation, by an order of magnitude. Our team likes to think across the whole model stack. In this role, you'll combine your deep expertise in machine learning engineering to develop novel evaluation frameworks and training strategies that push the frontier of what AI can achieve in biology.
You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and the biological sciences, developing rigorous methods to measure and improve model performance on complex scientific tasks. You'll collaborate closely with world-class researchers and engineers to build AI systems that can engage in all phases of research and development, while maintaining our commitment to safety and beneficial impact.
Previous experience in life sciences is welcome, but not required for this role.
Minimum Qualifications
Demonstrated experience training and evaluating large language models
Proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern ML development practices
Experience building and managing data pipelines for large-scale datasets
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and developing solutions in rapidly evolving research environments
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams
Preferred Qualifications
8+ years of machine learning experience
Prior work experience in AI and biology, including graduate studies (molecular biology, biochemistry, computational biology, or related fields)
Experience working with large-scale biological datasets
Published research or practical experience in scientific AI applications or long-horizon reasoning
Background in reinforcement learning and/or pretraining
Knowledge of containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud deployment at scale
Demonstrated ability to work across multiple domains, such as language modeling, systems engineering, and scientific computing
Contributions to open-source scientific software or databases

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit
anthropic.com/careers
directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.

jobs.description: Job Classification: Data Science & Analytics - Data Science & Analytics The Opportunity Marketing is transforming how it turns data into growth. At the center of that transformation is our MarTech , AI & Data Strategy team — the group that owns the platforms, data, and AI capabilities that power modern marketing. We are building one trusted, governed, AI-ready data foundation so that every marketer, model, and campaign draws from a single version of truth. The Director, Data Strategy & Activation Readiness leads the pillar responsible for that foundation — and for the portfolio of data products built on top of it. This is a builder's role for a leader who can set data strategy, shape a multi-year data product portfolio, stand up governance and identity, and make trusted, activation-ready data self-serve across the marketing organization. You will own the data and platform layer that feeds our analytics partners the clean, connected, closed-loop signal they need to prove and grow marketing's impact — while tying every data product to measurable value. Define and maintain a multi-year data product portfolio plan — surfacing new opportunities, modernization needs, and rationalization paths as priorities evolve. Establish clear standards for evaluating data product investments — expected value, feasibility, and adoption impact — so the team invests where it matters most. Champion data democratization — stand up self-serve access so marketers, and over time partners across Distribution, HR, and beyond, can query trusted data directly without manual pulls or analyst dependency. BUILD AND SCALE ACTIVATION-READY DATA PRODUCTS Define, build, and productize certified, AI-ready data products that are activation-ready out of the box, with no data prep required . Institutionalize the full data product lifecycle — from discovery and design through build, launch, iteration, and retirement. Drive user-centric product design — reliability, clarity, trust, and accessibility built in from the start. Define KPIs, success metrics, and ROI models for every data product , ensuring each one measurably improves decisioning , operational efficiency, omnichannel performance, and AI readiness. Own the marketing data intelligence layer — oversee its implementation and ongoing management so signals from every platform and source are clean, connected, structured, and ready for activation and measurement. ESTABLISH GOVERNANCE, IDENTITY, AND TRUST Establish and run the marketing data governance operating model — data quality SLAs, stewardship, standards, and clear accountability. Oversee metadata management, data lineage, and the data catalog so every data asset is discoverable, documented, and trusted. Evaluate, select, and implement an identity resolution capability to stitch identities across sources into one persistent, trusted customer and advisor profile — the enterprise identity spine. Align to enterprise standards by partnering with the Enterprise Data Office to keep marketing governance and identity consistent with enterprise policies and frameworks. ENSURE PRIVACY, COMPLIANCE, AND RESPONSIBLE DATA USE Ensure all marketing data is captured, stored, and used compliantly — consent-aware and privacy-first — in partnership with Privacy, Legal, and Compliance. Proactively manage data and operational risk alongside Legal, Compliance, and Security, embedding privacy-by-design across the foundation and every activation path. Champion responsible data usage and ethical AI practices across every data product and decisioning path. POWER ACTIVATION AND CLOSED-LOOP MEASUREMENT Own the data and audience layer of the CDP and marketing automation platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform, Marketo, SFMC) — ensuring profiles, segments, and audiences are governed, accurate , and activation-ready. Ensure data is captured from all sources — every channel, event, and touchpoint — and instrumented so the analytics team can execute closed-loop measurement and attribution. Own campaign taxonomy, signal/event capture, and attribution data re- ingestion so measurement becomes a continuous growth engine rather than a rear-view report. MONITOR, MEASURE, AND CONTINUOUSLY IMPROVE Implement ongoing performance monitoring across data products — availability, quality, usage, satisfaction, and business outcomes. Champion iteration and innovation through user feedback, usage insights, and emerging technology — continuously raising the bar on trust and value. LEAD ACROSS THE MATRIX Serve as the alignment hub for priorities, standards, roadmaps, and delivery timelines across Marketing, Analytics, Technology, Data Engineering, the Enterprise Data Office, Privacy, and Legal. Operate effectively without direct authority — influencing and aligning a complex stakeholder landscape. Manage up with clarity and confidence — keeping senior leadership informed, aligned, and bought in on strategy, trade-offs, and progress. Lead a blended team of employees and contractors spanning governance & readiness and delivery & automation . What You Bring REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 10 + years of progressive experience in data strategy, data management, data product management, or marketing data and technology, including time in a leadership or lead-architect capacity. Experience building and scaling data products or enterprise data platforms. Demonstrated ownership of core data governance disciplines — metadata management, data lineage, data cataloging, data quality, and stewardship. Hands-on experience evaluating and implementing identity resolution / identity graph capabilities and CDP platforms. Deep working knowledge of the modern MarTech and data stack — CDP (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform), marketing automation (e.g., Marketo, SFMC), and enterprise data environments (EDW / data warehouse) — plus a solid grasp of modern data engineering and architecture. Proven ability to partner with senior business executives, translate their priorities into roadmaps, and drive measurable value. Strong command of data privacy and consent requirements, and how to operationalize compliant data management in a regulated environment. Experience enabling analytics and measurement teams through instrumentation, taxonomy, and data capture that support closed-loop measurement and attribution. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, upward-management , and executive storytelling skills, including close partnership with an Enterprise Data Office or equivalent central data function. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience in financial services, insurance, or another regulated, data-sensitive industry. Familiarity with AI/ML enablement — preparing AI-ready data and supporting model deployment and real-time decisioning. Fluency with cloud-native data stacks and modern product management methodologies (Agile, Design Thinking, Lean Product). Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (data, computer science, engineering, analytics, or business); an advanced degree is a plus. Relevant certifications welcomed — e.g., data governance, Adobe/Salesforce platform credentials, or privacy (such as CIPP/US). The Ideal Candidate A strategist and a builder — comfortable setting vision and rolling up sleeves to stand up capabilities from the ground up. A product thinker — treats data as a product, obsessing over adoption, usability, and the value it creates for the people who use it. A translator — fluent in both business and marketing outcomes and the technical realities of data, platforms, and governance. An influencer — earns trust and drives alignment across senior and cross-functional stakeholders without leaning on authority. A steward — brings discipline and accountability to data quality, governance, privacy, and responsible AI. Biased for action — moves from strategy to production quickly, favoring standardization and speed. Outcome-oriented — ties every data investment to measurable marketing impact. How Success Is Measured Adoption and business impact of data products across marketing and partner functions. About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Anthropic is expanding its reseller program in Japan and Korea. As our Reseller Operations Manager for Japan and Korea, you'll own how resellers in both countries get onboarded, transact, get paid, and get supported, across both of our resale motions: hyperscaler resale, where partners resell Claude through the cloud marketplaces (AWS Bedrock today, Google Cloud Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry to follow), and direct resale, where partners resell on Anthropic paper through our own quote-to-order and billing systems. The global team builds the program; you make it work for Japanese and Korean partners and feed back what has to change.
This is an operator role, not a partner manager role. In the first months you'll be validating deal registrations and answering partner tickets yourself; by the end of the first year the volume should be running on documented process, service levels, and vendor or system coverage that you set up.
Key responsibilities
Own reseller onboarding for Japan and Korea end to end: application intake, screening coordination, agreement execution, marketplace authorization, entitlement setup, and activation, and keep the partner record in Salesforce decision-grade for both regions.
Run hyperscaler (3P) reseller operations: deal-registration intake and validation within SLA, marketplace authorizations and private-offer processing with the cloud alliance teams, and end-customer reporting on every reseller transaction so partner-sourced revenue can be attributed.

How this role works with the team
You'll report into Partner Experience and work day to day with two groups. The global Partner Operations team in San Francisco owns the reseller program's systems, and playbooks; our reseller operations owner there is your direct counterpart, and you'll split work along a simple line: they own the global process, you own its execution and adaptation in Japan and Korea. The Japan and Korea go-to-market teams own the partner relationships and the commercial conversations; you're the operational layer underneath them, and the person they come to when something about a partner's onboarding, order, or payout needs to move. jobs.description: Position Overview ABOUT APOLLO Apollo is a high-growth, global alternative asset manager. POSITION OVERVIEW: The incumbent will be part of Market Risk group. He/She will also be responsible for training and management of junior members of the team and take part in operational as well as strategic initiatives for the division. They will play an instrumental role in the enhancement of Risk function which is a critical part of our overall business strategy by partnering closely with the senior leadership team in Risk. Apollo is seeking an market risk professional with strong business acumen and technical skills to support its Market Risk function. The position will be responsible for monitoring and analyzing portfolio risks and engaging with Senior Portfolio Managers to identify drivers and exposures, respond to inquiries, and make recommendations that will ultimately influence investment behavior and portfolio construction. In addition, the incumbent will leverage their market risk experience and programming skills to develop tools that maximize efficiency and define how Apollo analyzes investment risks globally. The position also requires a strong project management, relationship management and people management skills, combined with a practical and hands-on experience in financial markets. Demonstrated ability to work effectively and independently across different businesses and functional areas with thorough attention to detail in a potentially high paced environment. Monitor investment risks of portfolios to ensure that risks are fully understood by portfolio managers and senior management and appropriately scaled consistent with clients’ objectives. Analyze portfolio risk utilizing analytical tools and techniques to facilitate discussions on portfolio construction. Utilize proprietary risk systems for monitoring of portfolio exposures, stress testing, risk and performance attribution. Conduct detailed reviews of portfolio’s risk and performance drivers and highlight areas of concern proactively. Partner with Analytics and Technology teams to develop, enhance, and deliver state-of-the-art risk analytics and models. Clearly and concisely articulate complex ideas to target audiences including portfolio managers, traders and executive management. Build and manage relationships with senior global stakeholders, and more importantly with local and regional business leaders, including internal and external parties. Be diplomatic and adaptable, but nonetheless be a forthright influencer and communicator, capable of understanding and managing the diverse requirements of numerous senior stakeholders. Qualifications & Experience 5+ years of experience as a risk manager or in trading in large Inv Banks or Asset Manager with an emphasis within the credit products. Deep expertise in credit market dynamics including cash, synthetics, and structured products. Strong understanding of quantitative traded credit methodologies and traded credit analytics. Preference for programming skills; proficiency with Python, SQL, and Excel. Developed scenario analysis using statistical models, simulation techniques, and other quantitative methods to assess risk exposures. Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution required; master’s degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, computer science, financial engineering, econometrics is preferred, but not required. Collaborative, organized, flexible and results driven. Must have strong drive and initiative, be collaborative to effectively liaise with senior stakeholders and colleagues. A forward thinking, creative individual who challenges the status quo and takes initiative to reengineer processes. Strong project management skills Excellent stakeholder management skills, including the ability to resolve conflict and observe confidentiality. Be nimble and flexible to balance multiple tasks simultaneously. The ability to take on a task and “run with it” to conclusion is a critical characteristic of this role.
